# Ariunbold Bold — Portfolio

> Software & hardware developer from Mongolia building full-stack web apps, embedded firmware, and hardware mods.

## Pages

- [Home](https://ariunbold.dev/en): Introduction, about, software + hardware projects, and career journey timeline.
- [About](https://ariunbold.dev/en/about): Background, core technologies, personal disciplines, and growth targets.
- [Projects](https://ariunbold.dev/en/projects): Hardware and software project showcase.
- [Contact](https://ariunbold.dev/en/contact): Ways to get in touch.

## Hardware Projects

- [ESP32 Animation](https://ariunbold.dev/en/work/esp32): C++ firmware decoding binary-encoded GIF frames onto a 128x64 OLED display.
- [CryoCell](https://ariunbold.dev/en/work/cryocell): Samsung Galaxy S21 mod with a custom 10,000mAh battery and active cooling.
- [Pusda Speaker Gen 2](https://ariunbold.dev/en/work/pusda-speaker): Upgraded stereo BT system — XH-MX8 amp, MH-MX8 receiver, dual isolated power rails (3.7V + 8.4V 2S), two 4Ω 15W drivers. Enclosure: the amp's shipping box.
- [Arch Linux Ricing & RGB Sync](https://ariunbold.dev/en/work/arch-ricing): Hyprland setup with wallpaper-reactive keyboard RGB.
